content: "Including your ex in personal activities can reopen emotional wounds, create confusion, and hinder your healing. It may give false hope or reinforce unhealthy attachments, delaying your ability to move forward. Prioritize your well-being by setting clear boundaries and focusing on growth without unnecessary pain." (50 words)
